name.zh: 暗黑武斗场 试炼之门 卡特斯

location.zh: 精灵太空站 暗黑武斗场 试炼之门

reward_note: Reward not recorded; clearing the 试炼之门 opened 暗黑第一门.

capture.zh: 暗黑武斗场的试炼精灵卡特斯守护试炼之门（官网图鉴：作为暗黑武斗场的试炼精灵，守护着试炼之门）。

strategy_notes.zh: 难度★：先用几只皮皮耗它的血，再换高等级先手精灵收尾。

engine_notes: Entry (original): 超能NoNo owners loaded the 反物质芯片 directly; others needed NoNo AI level 10 and a crafted 反物质芯片 (VIP-gated). Doors open in order: 试炼之门, then 暗黑第一门 … 第九门 (pre-2013). The remake drops the VIP gate.
Level and HP are not published (difficulty ★ per 7k7k); Lv60 / 600 HP follow the door-1..5 pattern of HP ≈ 10×level and are estimates.
source_note: 7k7k BOSS打法全攻略 (2010-06-02) lists 试练之门 卡特斯 ★; official 图鉴 calls it the trial guardian.
